question: In India, Financial Inclusion Index has ____ sub-indices.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index)** in India was introduced by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in **July 2021** to measure the level of financial inclusion across the country.
 
• The FI-Index comprises **three sub-indices:** **Access, Usage,** and **Quality**. These sub-indices are weighted to provide a comprehensive score representing the state of financial inclusion.
 
• **Access:** This sub-index measures the extent of availability of financial services, including the number of bank branches, ATMs, and banking correspondents.
 
• **Usage:** It captures the frequency and volume of transactions by individuals and entities, reflecting the extent of utilization of financial services.
 
• **Quality:** It evaluates the quality aspects of financial inclusion, such as financial literacy, consumer protection, and the resolution of grievances related to financial services.
 
• The FI-Index is computed annually and ranges from **0 to 100**, where 0 denotes complete financial exclusion and 100 represents full financial inclusion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objective of Financial Inclusion Index:**

 
 
• The FI-Index aims to provide policymakers and stakeholders with a comprehensive tool to assess the progress of financial inclusion and identify gaps for targeted interventions.
 
• It is a part of the broader initiative to achieve inclusive growth by bringing the unbanked population into the formal financial system.
 
 
 
• **Features of Financial Inclusion in India:**
 
 
• India has made significant strides in financial inclusion through initiatives such as the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)**, which provides access to basic bank accounts.
 
• Other schemes like **Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT)** and **Digital India** have further enhanced financial inclusion by promoting digital payments and banking services.
 
 
 
• **Global Context of Financial Inclusion:**
 
 
• The concept of financial inclusion is recognized globally as a key driver of economic development and poverty reduction.
 
• International organizations such as the **World Bank** and **IMF** emphasize financial inclusion as a critical component of their development agenda.
 
 
 
• **Important Facts:**
 
 
• India's FI-Index complements global indices such as the **Global Findex Database** created by the World Bank.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India has also launched various regulatory measures to promote financial inclusion, such as priority sector lending targets for banks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**

 
 
• The RBI serves as the central bank of India and plays a crucial role in promoting financial inclusion through various policies and frameworks.
 
• It launched the Financial Inclusion Index to track progress and enhance efforts for financial inclusion.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):**
 
 
• Launched in **August 2014**, PMJDY is India's flagship financial inclusion program aimed at providing universal access to banking facilities.
 
• It has been instrumental in connecting millions of unbanked individuals to the formal financial system.
 
 
 
• **Financial Literacy:**
 
 
• Financial literacy is a key component of the FI-Index's quality sub-index, emphasizing the importance of educating individuals about financial products and services.
 
• RBI and other stakeholders have launched numerous initiatives to promote financial literacy across India.
